key_catalyst: Alphabet raises 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B, triggering 4-5% selloff and reigniting AI capex ROI concerns across mega-cap tech
reasoning: Alphabet—QQQ's largest holding—dropped 4-5% on raised capex guidance to $195-205B, igniting a structural AI-spend ROI concern that is just beginning to be priced, while Tesla fell 4-8% on a 35% EPS miss and negative free cash flow. Simultaneously, Brent surged toward $96-100 on Houthi Red Sea attacks that widened the energy risk map beyond Hormuz, pushing the 10-year yield to 4.66-4.7%—its highest since January—and accelerating Fed hike repricing (now 42bps tightening priced by year-end). The convergence of first-mega-cap earnings disappointments with escalating oil and yields creates material overnight gap-down risk that the -0.72% intraday move has not fully absorbed.
